in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajbeer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raj means 'King' and Beer means 'God'. The name Rajbeer signifies a person who is the king of God, a powerful and strong individual who is a symbol of courage and bravery.
